intro: Zechariah, like Haggai, encouraged the exiles rebuilding the temple, through a series of night visions.
Chapters one to eight are visions and messages of hope for Jerusalem. Chapters nine to fourteen look far ahead, to a coming king.
Zechariah was a priest and a prophet, among those who returned from Babylon.
Christians hear Jesus here: a king coming lowly, riding upon an ass, and thirty pieces of silver. Listen too for: Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit.
